parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion hosts to which you want to create and add tags.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
An array that consists of IDs of bastion hosts.

Valid values: 1 to 20.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query IDs of bastion hosts.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource.

Set the value to **INSTANCE**, which indicates that the resource is a bastion host.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gc0000 --tag Value=operation_test Key=operation --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'bastionhost-cn-78v1gc0000' --Tag.1.Key operation --Tag.1.Value operation_test --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
